entries.camera: Extreme low-angle shot from the forest floor looking steeply up, wide lens, the figure a dark silhouette against the moon.
entries.subject: A hulking half-beast hunter seen from behind and below as a pure black silhouette, crouched on the broken parapet of a ruined watchtower in front of an enormous full moon. The tattered cloak has been torn into ribbons by the change, long clawed hands grip the crumbling stone with a faint ember-orange glow along the claws, and the bristling outline of fur runs across the shoulders. Far below, an endless sea of black pine forest under drifting mist, thin clouds crossing the moon.
entries.accent: cold moon-silver against deep forest green-black, with ember-orange claw glow

entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind and just above the hunter's hood, 35mm look, shallow depth of field, the glowing blade in sharp focus.
entries.subject: A hunter in a long dark coat with the hood up, seen only from behind, raises a straight sword in one gauntleted hand; its whole edge burns with the gold light of sunrise. In the ruined manor hall ahead hangs a tall faceless shroud of pale spectral mist, and wherever the golden light touches it the mist unravels into drifting glowing motes. Dawn pours through a shattered arched window, striping the dusty floorboards, a fallen chandelier and sheet-draped furniture.
entries.accent: sunrise gold against pale spectral teal mist

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead flat-lay view, symmetrical, 50mm look, the glowing flask at the exact centre of the frame.
entries.subject: Looking straight down at an alchemist's workbench: one thick-glassed flask of glowing acid-green mutagen held between two leather-gloved fingers, the hand cropped at the wrist, right at the centre. Beneath it a square steel plate is dissolving under a single drop of the liquid, hissing and pitted in a perfect smoking circle. Around it: a leather roll of stoppered vials, brass pliers, copper coils, a bubbling retort and a mortar of crushed luminous fungus.
entries.accent: toxic acid green with warm brass and copper

entries.camera: Canted dutch-angle wide shot from low behind the figure, strong perspective, the pact circle sweeping diagonally across the frame.
entries.subject: A hooded caster seen from behind at the edge of a cracked stone floor, one hand extended toward a black longsword planted point-down at the centre of a glowing circular pact seal made of abstract, non-legible crimson glyph shapes. Violet sparks of spellfire crawl up the blade. Above it towers the patron: a colossal rippling curtain of living void ringed with pinpoint violet stars, two long arcs of crimson light curling down like reaching hands toward the sword.
entries.accent: crimson-violet pact light against void black
